words_intro: No spoilers in these lists: titles, spellings and general words like "ending". Tap a word to copy it, or copy a group (one per line).
same_size: Same list size in every language.
core_sub: Hides spoiler talk, keeps news and trailers.
strict_sub: Every spelling of the title. Hides almost everything.
names_sub: a name can be a spoiler on its own, open only if you know them
plat_x: Notifications tab, gear icon, Muted, Muted words. Pick "Forever".
plat_threads: Threads: Profile, Menu, Content preferences, Hidden words, New filter. Instagram keeps its own list in Content preferences, Specific words and phrases (suggested posts only).
plat_tiktok: Profile, Menu, Settings and privacy, Content preferences, Filter keywords. Works in the For You and Following feeds, up to 100 words.
plat_youtube: "Not interested" and "Don't recommend channel". Comments and Shorts stay unfiltered.
plat_reddit: Mute communities from their menu. Titles in r/popular still get through.
plat_discord: Mute busy servers and channels for the first weeks.
miss1: A thumbnail can show the twist with no words at all.
miss3: Friends and group chats. Tell them early you have not seen it.
ext_p: Pure Spoiler Blocker has a ready list for {name}. It blurs matching videos, posts and comments on YouTube, Reddit and X, and keeps trailers and news.
ext_small: Also for Firefox. Checked in your browser, no account. Reads text only, desktop browsers only. I build it.

game.desc: How to avoid {name} spoilers: words to mute on X, Threads and TikTok, a ready list that blurs videos and posts on YouTube, Reddit and X, and what no filter catches.
game.lead: Players finish at different speeds, so the ending is online while many are still halfway. What to mute, where, and what no setting can catch.
game.why_h: Why it is hard to avoid
game.why:
Streams, "ending explained" videos and reaction clips put the big moments into thumbnails and titles, and they keep coming for weeks after {D0}.

Do not mute the bare series name: it also hides news, guides and other games. Use the core list below and strict mode for the first weeks.
game.nd_why:

Do not mute the bare series name: it also hides news, guides and other games. Use the core list below and strict mode for the first weeks.
game.unknown: Story moments the trailers never showed.
faq: What is the {name} release date?
Which words should I mute?
The game title with words like ending, final boss, who dies and spoilers. Muting only the series name also hides news and guides.
How long should I keep filters on?
Until you finish the story. Most spoilers come in the first weeks, but videos keep putting the ending in titles for months.
Can I mute words on YouTube?
No. YouTube has no keyword mute. In a desktop browser an extension can blur matching videos and comments.
